units.source_text: 此地风景之优美，自不必说。

en.t: The beauty of the scenery here goes without saying.

units.source_text: 这邸宅的构造也很有趣致：

en.t: The design of this residence is also very tasteful:

units.source_text: 庭院里的花木和假山，海里导入的泉水，布置都很巧妙。

en.t: The flowers and trees in the garden, the artificial hills, and the spring water drawn in from the sea are all arranged with great skill.

units.source_text: 如果要画下来，缺乏修养的画家还画不像呢。

en.t: If one tried to paint it, an uncultivated painter could hardly capture its likeness.

units.source_text: 这里与数月来须磨浦的住屋相比，明爽可爱得多。

en.t: Compared with the dwelling at Suma Bay over these past months, this place is far brighter, fresher, and more charming.
The interior furnishings are also perfect in every respect.

units.source_text: 其富丽堂皇，与京中高贵之家无异。

en.t: Its splendor and magnificence are no different from those of a noble house in the capital.

units.source_text: 不但如此，其绚焕灿烂，竟胜于京中邸宅。

en.t: More than that, its dazzling brilliance even surpasses the mansions of the capital.
